name: POST /api/mcp/tools/:tool_id/invoke — sdk-mcp-bridge
description: Capability-token-gated MCP tool invocation. Validates token against args, marks single-use, opens transport, calls /tools/call, persists mcp.tool_invocation + mcp.tool.invoked.v1. AC-12, FR-MCP-3.

testCases.name: Invoke an MCP tool via capability token

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in Bearer form (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
Bearer token fails JWT verification or is expired (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)

errorCases.code: tool_id must be a valid UUID
errorCases.message: tool_id must be a valid UUID
errorCases.when: The :tool_id path segment does not match the UUID regex (e.g. an unsubstituted ":tool_id" placeholder) - guarded up front so it cannot reach the query and 500
Body is absent or any of agent_run_id, capability_token_id, trace_id is missing/empty, or args is undefined (args may legitimately be null, 0 or an empty object)
invokeMcpTool returned normally with outcome !== "succeeded" (policy denial, capability-token rejection, upstream tool error) - the body still carries the full result object under data

errorCases.message: tenant opted out / registration status not enabled
errorCases.when: invokeMcpTool throws with a message containing "opted out" or "status=" - the tenant has opted out of the tool or the server registration is disabled
invokeMcpTool throws with a message containing "not found" - the tool_id, agent run or capability token does not exist
Any other invocation failure (transport error, database error)
